newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - HERMIS WANTS BIGGER STAKE IN SIAULIU BANK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - HERMIS WANTS BIGGER STAKE IN SIAULIU BANK.

text.p: Sources in Lithuania's central bank said on Tuesday that Hermis Bank wanted to acquire a 51 percent stake in Siauliu Bank.
The sources, who did not wish to be identified, said that Hermis, which already has a small stake in Siauliu Bank, had submitted an application to raise its stake to 51 percent.
Hermis is the second largest private bank in Lithuania and it has expressed an interest in buying into other banks.
Siauliu Bank is one of the country's smallest commercial banks and has been singled out by the central bank as a contender for merger.
It managed a net profit of 3.9 million litas last year after a loss of 2.9 million litas in 1995.
